adjudication.rationale: The diff removes the `afterModel` hooks that returned/chained `model.findMembers()` (admin_group_route.js and group-members.js.es6) and replaces them with `model.findMembers();` called in `setupController` without returning the promise. `Discourse.Group#findMembers` performs an AJAX request and only sets `members` inside `.then(...)`; on rejection (e.g., 403 from `GroupsController#members` due to `guardian.ensure_can_see!`, or network error), `members` never gets set and there is no error handling in the route/controller, so the UI can remain empty with no surfaced error. Previously, returning the promise from `afterModel` would at least propagate rejection to the route transition.
